scope: items 10-17 (보험부채_발생사고요소) only; items 1-9 are the 경영공시 2-4/2-5 extract

source_id_values.DART: source_file = the DART 사업/반기/분기보고서 (or 감사보고서 for 비상장사) XML the closing row was read from

note: values in the master are 억원 (DART 백만원 / 100, 2 decimals); checks.* are in 억원. basis=liability means item 15 closes against IFRS17_BS item 20 (부채인 보험계약, 별도); basis=net means the filer prints only NET (순부채(자산)) rows so item 15 is below item 20 by the 보험계약자산 offset. A source-absent (company, quarter) has no row and no cell here.
